title: Shadowed Grove
tagline: Shadowed Grove uses AI that automatically generates assets, monster stats will be obtained from onchain data. characters are stored on ipfs
description:
Shadowed Grove is an immersive video game that revolves around a hidden world inhabited by a magical tribe called "Aerandir," concealed within a strange and mystical forest. In the game, players assume the role of a newly initiated sorcerer who joins the Aerandir tribe. The forest has fallen under a curse, transforming its creatures into monstrous beings. Players embark on a journey to explore this mysterious forest, facing various challenges along the way. These challenges may include defeating magical creatures, with each victory granting the player valuable items and rewards. 
Magical monster creater :
There will be a gas monitoring server on the optimis environment that generates monsters with stats based on the gas price of that time period.
how_its_made:
This project use
- react: i use react for render frontend
- mud: to develop onchain game storage 
- NFT.Storage: to save asset 
- scenario: AI that create assets
I use a server to listen for changes on the optimis network and then the trigger generates random monsters. Their images are created from AI, then stored on ipfs
